P0-01.title: Contract SHA mismatch in receipt

Design contract SHA: '58d9bed2f0c432397034bdccdf69194640fa7dc2d1ac030ca43e5a6f01dc4349'. Neither matches the receipt's claim.
P0-01.recommendation: Recompute contract SHA-256 and update receipt's contract_sha256 field to match the file actually on disk.

findings.title: Contract SHA mismatch in receipt — continued from prior review
findings.detail: Receipt claims contract_sha256='274d440ba4f3e4920944c47fe4afb48d7dece80e071b94273b49b097ed3830e3'. Actual implementation contract SHA is e9a5cf7a79ca0ca131e42ed6acdb0ad19f6437fe50f3d6ee60d3220ffe467c06. Design contract SHA is 58d9bed2f0c432397034bdccdf69194640fa7dc2d1ac030ca43e5a6f01dc4349. Neither matches.
findings.recommendation: Recompute contract SHA-256 and update receipt. Ensure both files are frozen simultaneously.

findings.title: Protected runtime files have pre-existing uncommitted changes
findings.detail: cli.py, model_router.py, runtime.py have uncommitted changes predating Phase 2B. Acknowledged as pre-existing. Not blocking but should be resolved in a separate PR before Phase 2B commit.
findings.recommendation: Commit or stash these changes before Phase 2B commit.

findings.title: MemoryKind enum missing 'experience' value
findings.detail: ExperienceLearner uses raw string 'experience' in 4 locations (record_outcome, extract_patterns, rank_experiences, prune_irrelevant). MemoryKind enum has 13 values but no EXPERIENCE member. consolidation_rules.py now handles the raw string correctly, but the enum gap means no IDE autocomplete, no type checking, and no documentation for this kind.
findings.recommendation: Add MemoryKind.EXPERIENCE = 'experience' to models.py enum and reference it in experience_learner.py and consolidation_rules.py.

findings.title: MockMC _LAYER_MAP has dead 'lesson' entry
findings.detail: conftest.py maps 'lesson':'procedural' but no code path uses kind='lesson'. record_lesson uses kind='procedural'. Real KIND_TO_LAYER has no 'lesson' key — classify_layer('lesson') would default to 'semantic' in production.
findings.recommendation: Remove 'lesson' entry from MockMC _LAYER_MAP, or add 'lesson':'procedural' to real KIND_TO_LAYER if the kind is planned for future use.

findings.title: Contract method counts don't match actual code
findings.detail: Contract claims PREF-01 has 6 methods (actual: 8 — record_preference, get_preference, get_all_preferences, rank_preferences, apply_decay, resolve_conflict, get_profile, summarize). EXP-01 claims 6 methods (actual: 7 — record_outcome, record_lesson, extract_patterns, rank_experiences, get_lessons, prune_irrelevant, summarize).
findings.recommendation: Update contract method counts or define counting methodology explicitly.

findings.title: Unnecessary # noqa: F401 on used import
findings.detail: experience_learner.py line 5: 'import json  # noqa: F401'. json is used throughout (json.dumps on lines 65, 124; json.loads on lines 75, 110, 129). F401 would never fire.

findings.title: apply_decay is per-call, not time-based
findings.detail: While half_life_hours parameter is now consumed (CF-003 fix), decay is applied on each call regardless of elapsed time. No created_at timestamp comparison. Docstring says 'Decay preferences' but doesn't specify time-based behavior, so this is acceptable behavior — but the half_life_hours name implies time-awareness.
findings.recommendation: Rename to decay_per_call or implement time-based decay using created_at timestamps.

findings.title: prune_irrelevant returns count but doesn't actually prune
findings.detail: experience_learner.py prune_irrelevant() counts low-confidence records but never deletes them. Method name is misleading.
findings.recommendation: Rename to count_low_confidence_experiences or implement actual pruning via MemoryController.
